Ask clearer questions, understand contracts better
Specify the contract and clause you want to understand. Ask one question at a time, then ask AI to explain or point to related content.

1. Tap the paperclip next to the chat input.

2. Choose a document you are authorized to use and check its name.

3. Enter a question and send it when file sending is connected.

Currently, files are selected for preview only and are not sent to AI.
What if the AI answer lacks evidence?
Ask AI to identify the relevant clause or text. Compare it with the original document. If the evidence is missing or unclear, do not rely on the result; consult a legal professional.
Why cannot AI read a document?
Check that the file opens, the scan is clear and review any error message; retry with a clearer document if necessary.
Can I ask follow-up questions in the same chat?
You can ask follow-up questions in the current conversation and specify the clause you want clarified.
How should I check an answer?
Compare the answer with the original document and consult a legal professional when making decisions.
AI may make mistakes or omit information. Check the original document; answers are for reference and do not replace a legal professional.
